subject.title: fix #94850: remove Lobstering from default progress draft labels

question: Should the automatic progress-draft default pool be fully neutralized before this PR can close the linked neutral-default issue, or is removing only `Lobstering` acceptable?
rationale: The current shipped docs and feature history made themed automatic labels intentional, while the linked issue asks for mascot/novelty labels to be opt-in; automation cannot choose the permanent user-facing tone.

options.title: Neutralize full default pool
options.body: Require maintainer-approved neutral labels for the whole automatic pool, with docs, tests, and rendered proof aligned before merge.

options.title: Accept one-label scope
options.body: Merge only the `Lobstering` removal while explicitly accepting the remaining themed defaults and the smaller default pool.

options.title: Pause for canonical wording
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it after maintainers choose a different canonical wording path for the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Neutralize full default pool
recommendation.body: Require maintainer-approved neutral labels for the whole automatic pool, with docs, tests, and rendered proof aligned before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the progress-drafts feature and default label policy this PR changes.
